svg.text: Lay it out like this before you start
Same arrangement as every later picture, so you never have to turn anything round in your head. A4 sheet of paper for scale; USB cable stays in the bag until Part 4.
your table, seen from above, you sit at the bottom
Write the screen's pin order here: ____ ____ ____ ____
Clock stays in the bag today.
Count them now. Missing one at step 3 costs ten minutes of doubt.
Breadboard, long way across, red rail at the top
The + rail (red line) must be the one nearest
the top of the table. If your board has rails on
both edges, use the top pair and ignore the bottom.
PocketBeagle 2, sockets up, USB-C port to the LEFT
Turned so its P1 strip is the one nearest the
breadboard. Pin 1 is then at the left end of P1,
the end by the USB-C port. Check the printed 1.
A wire leaving P1 goes straight up into the
